title: factory: two stores and an assembler
summary: Chassis and engines made by two threads into stores of a size given at run time; a third thread assembles cars, then everything closes in order.
hints: Each store is a circular buffer allocated with `malloc` of the size given in the arguments. Protect it as in the producer/consumer exercises: one semaphore counts free slots, another counts items, a mutex protects the indices.
Every producer makes exactly `CARS` items, so nobody has to be woken up to stop: the assembler takes `CARS` chassis and `CARS` engines and all three threads simply end.
Keep the highest number of items each store ever held (under its mutex) to prove that the size was respected.
Join the three threads, then free the memory and destroy the semaphores and mutexes, and only then print `Factory closed`.
